sufficient_for.note: 5/6 quotes do not license diagnostic sufficiency. Exception: CPVT consensus item 2 'diagnosed in patients who have a pathogenic mutation' is sufficient_for (not required_for). The other five are therapy-sufficient, consider EMB, molecular autopsy request, may suggest evaluation, echo first-level imaging.

excludes.note: Schema excludes = finding PRESENT rules the disease out. 124/134 are polarity=negated (‘without/do not/absence/No’ table cells), which is feature_of+negated or a workup/treatment prohibition, not excludes. The 4 LQTS ‘normal QTc <440/460 ms’ rows are the cutoff that should have been required_for prolonged QTc, written as excludes+negated. Asserted 10/10 are definitional ‘in the absence of…’, inverted lists, or the opposite of the quote (channelopathies may cause SIDS).
